# DeployCloud Blog — Build Instructions

## Overview

Build a modern tech blog landing page for **DeployCloud**, a cloud deployment platform. This is a content hub targeting developers, engineering teams, and technical decision-makers. The page should feel like a polished editorial experience — think Vercel's blog or Cloudflare's blog: clean, information-dense, and fast-looking.

## Visual Direction

- **Palette**: Predominantly white/light gray background with deep navy or near-black text. Use a vibrant accent color (electric blue or orange) sparingly for interactive elements like category pills and CTAs.
- **Typography**: Use a modern sans-serif system font stack (Inter, or similar). Headlines should be bold and large; body text clean and readable. Generous line-height for editorial comfort.
- **Layout**: Spacious, grid-based. The featured articles section should feel hero-like and visually distinct from the chronological feed below.
- **Cards**: Blog post cards should have subtle borders or shadows, with hover states that feel responsive. Include category tags, dates, titles, short excerpts, and author avatars.

## Key Priorities

1. **Category filtering is the core interaction** — the pill buttons must feel snappy. When a user selects a category, the post grid should visibly update. Combine this with the search input so both filters work together seamlessly. Show a clear "no results" state when nothing matches.

2. **Featured articles deserve visual weight** — these three cards are the editorial showcase. Make them larger, more prominent, and visually differentiated from the latest news grid. The agentic infrastructure stats (30% of deployments, 1000% increase, etc.) should be woven into the featured content naturally.

3. **Navigation dropdowns** — the Products and Resources mega menus should be polished and well-organized, reinforcing that this blog belongs to a serious platform company.

4. **"Show more posts"** — implement this as a progressive reveal from pre-loaded data, appending additional cards to the grid without a page reload.

5. **Responsive design** is required — the 3-column grid should collapse gracefully to 2 and then 1 column on smaller screens.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

  const renderAvatars = (post) => {
    return post.authors.map((author, i) =>
      `<div class="avatar ${post.avatarColors[i] || ''}" aria-hidden="true" title="${author}">${post.avatarInitials[i] || author.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</div>`
    ).join('');
  };

  const renderCard = (post) => `
    <article class="news-card" role="listitem" data-id="${post.id}" data-category="${post.category}">

        <span class="tag ${tagClass(post.category)}">${post.category}</span>

      <time class="news-card__date" datetime="${post.dateISO}">${post.date}</time>
      <h3 class="news-card__title">${post.title}</h3>
      <p class="news-card__excerpt">${post.excerpt}</p>
      <footer class="news-card__footer">
        ${renderAvatars(post)}
        <span class="news-card__author-name">${post.authors.join(' & ')}</span>
      </footer>
    </article>
  `;

  const filteredPosts = () => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return POSTS.filter(p => {

      const searchMatch = !q ||
        p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.authors.some(a => a.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        p.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return catMatch && searchMatch;
    });
  };

  const renderGrid = () => {
    const posts = filteredPosts();
    const visible = posts.slice(0, visibleCount);

    /* Remove old cards (keep no-results placeholder) */
    Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card')).forEach(c => c.remove());

    if (visible.length === 0) {
      noResults.classList.add('visible');
      showMoreBtn.disabled = true;
      showMoreBtn.style.display = 'none';
      return;

    noResults.classList.remove('visible');
    visible.forEach(p => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.innerHTML = renderCard(p);
      grid.appendChild(div.firstElementChild);
    });

    const hasMore = posts.length > visibleCount;
    showMoreBtn.disabled = !hasMore;
    showMoreBtn.style.display = hasMore ? '' : 'none';
  };

  /* ── CATEGORY PILLS ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      activeCategory = btn.dataset.category;
      visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
      renderGrid();
    });
  });

  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    searchQuery = searchInput.value;
    visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
  });

  /* ── SHOW MORE ── */
  showMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    visibleCount += POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
    /* Scroll to first new card */
    const cards = grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
    if (cards.length > POSTS_PER_PAGE) {

  renderGrid();

  /* ── KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY for dropdowns ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    const btn = item.querySelector('.nav-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.dropdown');
    if (!btn || !dropdown) return;

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();

      /* Close all */
      document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
        d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));

        dropdown.style.opacity = '1'; dropdown.style.visibility = 'visible';
        dropdown.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; dropdown.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
      d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
  });

  const POSTS_PER_PAGE = 8;

  const grid = document.getElementById('news-grid');
  const noResults = document.getElementById('no-results');
  const showMoreBtn = document.getElementById('show-more-btn');
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('search-input');

  /* ── TAG CLASS ── */
  const tagClass = (cat) => {
    const map = {
      'Engineering': 'tag--engineering',
      'Customers': 'tag--customers',
      'Security': 'tag--security',
      'Community': 'tag--community',
      'Company News': 'tag--company',
      'v0': 'tag--v0',
      'Changelog': 'tag--changelog',
      'Press': 'tag--press',
    };
    return map[cat] || '';
  };

  /* ── RENDER AVATAR GROUP ── */
  const renderAvatars = (post) => {
    return post.authors.map((author, i) =>
      `<div class="avatar ${post.avatarColors[i] || ''}" aria-hidden="true" title="${author}">${post.avatarInitials[i] || author.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</div>`
    ).join('');
  };

  /* ── RENDER SINGLE CARD ── */
  const renderCard = (post) => `
    <article class="news-card" role="listitem" data-id="${post.id}" data-category="${post.category}">
      <div class="news-card__tags">
        <span class="tag ${tagClass(post.category)}">${post.category}</span>

      <time class="news-card__date" datetime="${post.dateISO}">${post.date}</time>
      <h3 class="news-card__title">${post.title}</h3>
      <p class="news-card__excerpt">${post.excerpt}</p>
      <footer class="news-card__footer">
        ${renderAvatars(post)}
        <span class="news-card__author-name">${post.authors.join(' & ')}</span>
      </footer>
    </article>
  `;

  /* ── FILTER POSTS ── */
  const filteredPosts = () => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return POSTS.filter(p => {
      const catMatch = activeCategory === 'all' || p.category === activeCategory;
      const searchMatch = !q ||
        p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.authors.some(a => a.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        p.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return catMatch && searchMatch;
    });
  };

  /* ── RENDER GRID ── */
  const renderGrid = () => {
    const posts = filteredPosts();
    const visible = posts.slice(0, visibleCount);

    /* Remove old cards (keep no-results placeholder) */
    Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card')).forEach(c => c.remove());

    if (visible.length === 0) {
      noResults.classList.add('visible');
      showMoreBtn.disabled = true;
      showMoreBtn.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    noResults.classList.remove('visible');
    visible.forEach(p => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.innerHTML = renderCard(p);
      grid.appendChild(div.firstElementChild);
    });

    const hasMore = posts.length > visibleCount;
    showMoreBtn.disabled = !hasMore;
    showMoreBtn.style.display = hasMore ? '' : 'none';
  };

  /* ── CATEGORY PILLS ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      activeCategory = btn.dataset.category;
      visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
      renderGrid();
    });
  });

  /* ── SEARCH ── */
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    searchQuery = searchInput.value;
    visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
  });

  /* ── SHOW MORE ── */
  showMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    visibleCount += POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
    /* Scroll to first new card */
    const cards = grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
    if (cards.length > POSTS_PER_PAGE) {
      cards[POSTS_PER_PAGE - 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  });

  /* ── INIT ── */
  renderGrid();

  /* ── KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY for dropdowns ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    const btn = item.querySelector('.nav-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.dropdown');
    if (!btn || !dropdown) return;

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const isOpen = dropdown.style.opacity === '1';
      /* Close all */
      document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
        d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      if (!isOpen) {
        dropdown.style.opacity = '1'; dropdown.style.visibility = 'visible';
        dropdown.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; dropdown.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
      d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
  });

})();
</script>

      'Customers': 'tag--customers',
      'Security': 'tag--security',
      'Community': 'tag--community',
      'Company News': 'tag--company',
      'v0': 'tag--v0',
      'Changelog': 'tag--changelog',
      'Press': 'tag--press',
    };
    return map[cat] || '';
  };

  /* ── RENDER AVATAR GROUP ── */
  const renderAvatars = (post) => {
    return post.authors.map((author, i) =>
      `<div class="avatar ${post.avatarColors[i] || ''}" aria-hidden="true" title="${author}">${post.avatarInitials[i] || author.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase()}</div>`
    ).join('');
  };

  /* ── RENDER SINGLE CARD ── */
  const renderCard = (post) => `
    <article class="news-card" role="listitem" data-id="${post.id}" data-category="${post.category}">
      <div class="news-card__tags">
        <span class="tag ${tagClass(post.category)}">${post.category}</span>
      </div>
      <time class="news-card__date" datetime="${post.dateISO}">${post.date}</time>
      <h3 class="news-card__title">${post.title}</h3>
      <p class="news-card__excerpt">${post.excerpt}</p>
      <footer class="news-card__footer">
        ${renderAvatars(post)}
        <span class="news-card__author-name">${post.authors.join(' & ')}</span>
      </footer>
    </article>
  `;

  /* ── FILTER POSTS ── */
  const filteredPosts = () => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    return POSTS.filter(p => {
      const catMatch = activeCategory === 'all' || p.category === activeCategory;
      const searchMatch = !q ||
        p.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.excerpt.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
        p.authors.some(a => a.toLowerCase().includes(q)) ||
        p.category.toLowerCase().includes(q);
      return catMatch && searchMatch;
    });
  };

  /* ── RENDER GRID ── */
  const renderGrid = () => {
    const posts = filteredPosts();
    const visible = posts.slice(0, visibleCount);

    /* Remove old cards (keep no-results placeholder) */
    Array.from(grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card')).forEach(c => c.remove());

    if (visible.length === 0) {
      noResults.classList.add('visible');
      showMoreBtn.disabled = true;
      showMoreBtn.style.display = 'none';
      return;
    }

    noResults.classList.remove('visible');
    visible.forEach(p => {
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.innerHTML = renderCard(p);
      grid.appendChild(div.firstElementChild);
    });

    const hasMore = posts.length > visibleCount;
    showMoreBtn.disabled = !hasMore;
    showMoreBtn.style.display = hasMore ? '' : 'none';
  };

  /* ── CATEGORY PILLS ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(btn => {
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(b => {
        b.classList.remove('active');
        b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'false');
      });
      btn.classList.add('active');
      btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', 'true');
      activeCategory = btn.dataset.category;
      visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
      renderGrid();
    });
  });

  /* ── SEARCH ── */
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', () => {
    searchQuery = searchInput.value;
    visibleCount = POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
  });

  /* ── SHOW MORE ── */
  showMoreBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
    visibleCount += POSTS_PER_PAGE;
    renderGrid();
    /* Scroll to first new card */
    const cards = grid.querySelectorAll('.news-card');
    if (cards.length > POSTS_PER_PAGE) {
      cards[POSTS_PER_PAGE - 1].scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'nearest' });
    }
  });

  /* ── INIT ── */
  renderGrid();

  /* ── KEYBOARD ACCESSIBILITY for dropdowns ── */
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-item').forEach(item => {
    const btn = item.querySelector('.nav-link');
    const dropdown = item.querySelector('.dropdown');
    if (!btn || !dropdown) return;

    btn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      const isOpen = dropdown.style.opacity === '1';
      /* Close all */
      document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
        d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
      });
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav-link').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
      if (!isOpen) {
        dropdown.style.opacity = '1'; dropdown.style.visibility = 'visible';
        dropdown.style.transform = 'translateY(0)'; dropdown.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
        btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      }
    });
  });

  document.addEventListener('click', () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('.dropdown').forEach(d => {
      d.style.opacity = ''; d.style.visibility = ''; d.style.transform = ''; d.style.pointerEvents = '';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[aria-expanded]').forEach(b => b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false'));
  });

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

The DeployCloud blog landing page is built at `/app/output/index.html`. Here's what's included:

**Structure & Content**
- Sticky header with Products mega-menu (3-column: AI Cloud, Core Platform, Security) and Resources dropdown — both toggle on click with keyboard accessibility

- Featured articles: 2-column asymmetric grid — main card spans 2 rows with inline stats strip (30%, 1000%, 20×), two secondary cards beside it
- Latest news: 3-column card grid driven by JavaScript, with tag colors per category
- CTA banner: side-by-side "Start Deploying / Talk to Expert" and dark "Explore Enterprise" cards
- Footer: 10-column link grid + status badge

**Interactions**
- Category pills filter the news grid instantly, updating `aria-pressed` state
- Search input filters by title, excerpt, author, and category simultaneously
- Both filters work together — "no results" state shown with message
- "Show more posts" reveals 4 additional pre-loaded posts (12 total), then hides itself
- Mega menus open/close on click, close on outside click

**Design**
- Brand colors: `#171717`, `#0072F5`, `#FAFAFA` as specified
- Inter font, editorial spacing, hover states on all cards
- Responsive: 3-col → 2-col → 1-col at 1024px and 768px breakpoints
- No build step required — opens directly in a browser
